# The branches a pull request is delivered into, one per line.
#
# These are the branches whose pull requests must keep a complete CI verdict:
# a push to the head of such a pull request arrives faster than the suite runs,
# so the run in progress is allowed to finish instead of being cancelled by the
# next one. Every workflow's `concurrency.cancel-in-progress` expression must
# name every branch listed here (ci-concurrency-scope gate).
#
# A retired branch is removed from this file in the same change that retires
# it. Keeping a name that no longer heads a delivery pull request is how the
# guards in 36 workflow files stopped firing on 2026-11-22 while still reading
# like an exemption.
testnet-50
